finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files.** All parse clean under `node --check`.

Files were spread over all six packages, in `repo`, `service`, and `admin` layers.

I left `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` alone. It holds 2 calls. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it.

`cache.query` is a different object. I did not touch it.

Next: drop `db.query` from [lib/db.js:13](lib/db.js:13) once you can shim the vendor file.
